does.text: Only queues: appends (entity, explosion name FixedString) to the system's own pending array, which the next Update turns into a component change. A null name is how a clear is requested.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll (Toolkit build) pseudo-code, ScriptedExplosionSystem::AnubisSetScriptedExplosion at +0x122BFB0 (95 lines): array append, no component call

does.text: For every queued (entity, name) whose entity is still alive: if the name is null (the FixedString null index -1) and the entity has eoc::spell::ScriptedExplosionComponent, the component is removed with a deferred RemoveComponent. If the name is set and the entity has no such component yet, ScriptedExplosionComponent (a 4-byte component holding one FixedString) is ADDED and then set to the name; if it already exists its value is overwritten. The entity is marked dirty for replication in both cases. The queue is cleared afterwards.
